profile.name: Ashik Rai
profile.tagline: Backend-first Engineer (C++, Go, gRPC) who also ships full-stack | Observability & Systems Reliability
profile.bioShort: Hi there, I'm Ashik — a Software Engineer based in India, currently working at IBM.
profile.bioLong: I'm a Backend-focused Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and building high-performance, reliable systems in C++, Go, and JavaScript/TypeScript, complemented by strong front-end delivery using React.js. Proven track record building observability and telemetry pipelines (eBPF, Prometheus, Grafana), production-grade APIs (gRPC, Protocol Buffers, REST), and payment platforms for global banking and airline clients. Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI workflows with n8n and Flowise — including Agentic RAG pipelines, MCP server/client integrations, vector-embedding search with Supabase, and voice-enabled conversational agents — and applying AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery and improve code quality. Adept at cross-functional collaboration, rapid learning of new technology stacks, and translating complex requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.

description: Designed and developed a lightweight flow collection service from scratch to replace Skydive for IBM Cloud, leveraging eBPF probes to collect network flow statistics (packets and bytes) directly from the Linux kernel and NIC.
Reduced memory footprint, binary size, and operational overhead of the network telemetry pipeline while maintaining full flow-data coverage for IBM Cloud customers.
Automated multi-region alert deployment verification via the IBM Cloud API , eliminating manual region-by-region checks.
Designed and built a React.js monitoring application from the ground up, integrating IBM Cloud Services, reducing status monitoring effort by over 90%.
Implemented centralized, multi-region alert report generation, for deployment status tracking across team.

Designed and developed Grafana dashboards for production observability, visualizing historical metrics, time-series data, anomaly patterns, and system health, enabling faster issue detection and root cause analysis.

Built and maintained metric-based alerts using Prometheus and PromQL , and log-based alerts using IBM Cloud Logs (ICL) to drive performance optimization and Service Level Management (SLOs), proactively monitoring production environments.

Shipped new product features in Fabcon and IOBricks, including enabling core dump generation for improved debugging, introducing new application metrics to enhance observability, and strengthening production readiness.
Built internal automation tooling that streamlined the alert-creation lifecycle, reducing manual engineering effort.
Defined alerting strategies and mitigation runbooks, supporting rapid incident recovery and improved production reliability.
Led security scanning across multiple repositories using Fortify, BlackDuck, Secrets, and Prisma, identifying and remediating exploitable vulnerabilities prior to production deployment.
Triaged scan findings end-to-end, prioritizing legitimate risks and suppressing false positives to keep remediation focused and efficient.
Generated comprehensive reports for multiple airline clients by querying databases and using tools such as SI-Viewer and custom scripts.
Partnered with cross-functional development teams to translate scan insights into actionable code-quality and security best practices.
Built and deployed a Python (Paramiko) automation tool that cut manual reporting effort by 95% for major clients.
Integrated AWS MQTT service into a payment application to enable real-time system updates and bank notifications for merchants, improving customer acquisition.
Integrated AWS Polly into payment workflows, enhancing user experience and driving more business customers.
Pioneered BScanC payment functionality for the Thailand Payment Application, expanding market capabilities.
Modernized key management by building a new Key-Injection Tool to replace legacy processes.
Developed payment applications in C++ and Android for industry clients HDFC, SBI, FirstData, Hitachi, KBANK (Thailand).
Developed and enhanced responsive web applications using React.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and GraphQL . Built reusable UI components with Material UI with efficient state management using Redux.
Contributed to a full redesign and modernization of the company’s web platform, improving UX and performance.
Championed code quality and maintainability through SASS, ES6, TypeScript, GraphQL adoption and best-practice advocacy.

testimonials.quote: I have known Ashik for nine years at the time of writing this recommendation: initially as (closely known) junior at my college and later as a colleague in Verifone. One thing that defines him is his nature of giving his 100% to anything at hand. He is ready to take up all the time that he can afford but always ends up with the finest outcome he could have ever achieved. As a person, though he seems little introvert in a new environment, once he has opened up he can lit up any team. Technically, he is a programmer from heart (passion driven profession). I would not think twice for an opportunity to work with him.
